result.instructions: Tools for HelpCrunch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many live chats are open right now, and who is handling them?"; "Show me the messages in the most recent chat from a customer."; "Which agents and departments do we have set up?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HelpCrunch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run helpcrunch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run helpcrunch_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run helpcrunch_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. helpcrunch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List / search customers (people who chatted in). Optionally filter with a single field/operator/value clause (comparison AND), sort (e.g. customers.firstSeen, customers.lastSeen) with order, and paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: POST /customers/search.

field.description: Field to filter on (e.g. customers.email, chats.status).

operator.description: Filter comparison operator (used with field + value).

value.description: Value to compare the field against (used with field + operator).

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. customers.firstSeen / customers.lastSeen.

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id. HelpCrunch REST: GET /customers/{id}.

id.description: The customer id (numeric id, passed as a string).

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_chats
tools.title: List chats
tools.description: List / search chats (conversations). Optionally filter with a single field/operator/value clause (comparison AND), sort (e.g. chats.createdAt) with order, and paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: POST /chats/search.

field.description: Field to filter on (e.g. customers.email, chats.status).

operator.description: Filter comparison operator (used with field + value).

value.description: Value to compare the field against (used with field + operator).

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. chats.createdAt.

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_chat
tools.title: Get chat
tools.description: Get a single chat (conversation) by id. HelpCrunch REST: GET /chats/{id}.

id.description: The chat id (numeric id, passed as a string).

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_chat_messages
tools.title: Get chat messages
tools.description: Get the messages of a chat (conversation), newest first (sorted by createdAt DESC). Paginate with limit (max 100) / offset. HelpCrunch REST: GET /chats/{id}/messages.

id.description: The chat id (numeric id, passed as a string).

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agents (support staff / operators) in the account, with role and email. Paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: GET /agents.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments (groups of agents that chats can be routed to), each with its agents. Paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: GET /departments.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List applications configured in the account — web chat widgets, iOS/Android apps, and social integrations (id, name, displayName, active, type). HelpCrunch REST: GET /applications.

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Get the organization's live-chat availability status — domain, whether the team is online (teamOnline), and whether chat is enabled (chatEnabled). HelpCrunch REST: GET /organization.

tools.name: helpcrunch_create_message
tools.title: Create message
tools.description: POSTS a message into a LIVE chat — a customer-visible reply (type "message") or an internal private note (type "private"). Set `agent` (agent id) for agent messages; omit it for customer messages. HelpCrunch REST: POST /messages.

chat.description: The chat id to post the message into.

agent.description: Agent id — required for agent messages; omit for customer messages.

markdown_text.description: Optional markdown version of the message (→ markdownText).

tools.name: helpcrunch_update_chat_status
tools.title: Update chat status
tools.description: CHANGES the status of a LIVE chat (e.g. mark it opened, pending, on hold, or closed). HelpCrunch REST: PUT /chats/status.

tools.name: helpcrunch_assign_chat
tools.title: Assign chat
tools.description: ASSIGNS (or unassigns) a LIVE chat to an agent. Pass `assignee` (agent id) to assign; omit it (or pass null) to unassign. HelpCrunch REST: PUT /chats/assignee.

assignee.description: Agent id to assign the chat to. Omit (or null) to unassign.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with HelpCrunch
prompts.description: What you can do with HelpCrunch here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_chats_by_field_and_sort_them_by_date
prompts.title: Find chats by field and sort them by date
prompts.description: The AI searches chats with one field filter and sorts them, for example by creation date. You get a list of conversations to look at first.

prompts.name: read_and_summarize_a_chat
prompts.title: Read and summarize a chat
prompts.description: The AI reads the messages of a chat, newest first, and sums up what the customer asked and what was answered.

prompts.name: reply_in_a_chat_or_add_a_private_note
prompts.title: Reply in a chat or add a private note
prompts.description: The AI posts a customer-visible reply or an internal private note into a live chat, as the agent you name.

prompts.name: close_reopen_or_assign_a_chat
prompts.title: Close, reopen or assign a chat
prompts.description: The AI changes the status of a live chat (opened, pending, on hold, closed) and assigns it to an agent or removes the assignee.

prompts.name: look_up_customers_by_first_or_last_seen
prompts.title: Look up customers by first or last seen
prompts.description: The AI searches customers with one field filter and sorts them by first seen or last seen. It reads the details of one customer by id.

prompts.name: check_agents_departments_and_team_availability
prompts.title: Check agents, departments and team availability
prompts.description: The AI lists agents with role and email, departments with their agents, and whether the team is online and chat is enabled.
